corrected_findings.issue: Provider mutated effect counter/dedup before persist and continued serving errors; cached success could follow failed durability
corrected_findings.resolution: Operate on a cloned candidate, persist complete candidate atomically before publication; propagate storage errors out of service. Injected ENOSPC verifies fail-stop/no success and restart reconciliation.

corrected_findings.issue: LEASE generation and durable request reply were separate commits; crash between them repeated lease increment
corrected_findings.resolution: LEASE generation, effects and requestID-bound exact reply have one durable candidate commit. lease_committed fault occurs after this commit and before mailbox response; all130 resumed cases retain generation2, with exactly2durable lease replies.

corrected_findings.issue: Original Unix socket unavailable in executor
corrected_findings.resolution: Preserved EPERM failure and narrowed tested transport to durable local filesystem mailbox; no network qualification.
